description: This file is a script for checking and enforcing safe usage of window.open in the codebase. It collects TypeScript files from a specified directory, searches for raw window.open calls, and reports violations.

methods.name: findRawWindowOpenLines
methods.description: Analyzes source content to locate all instances where raw window.open calls are made outside of safe helper functions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that collects files, searches for violations, and outputs messages or errors accordingly.
